<h1><a name="_Toc156841852">"The Power of Now" : Brief overview of
the book and its central theme.</a></h1>

<p><span style="font-size: 14.0pt;">"The Power of Now" by Eckhart Tolle
is a profound and transformative guide that invites readers to embark on a
journey toward spiritual awakening and a heightened state of consciousness.
Published in 1997, the book has since gained widespread acclaim for its
compelling insights into the nature of human suffering and the transformative
potential found in the present moment.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size: 14.0pt;">At its core, "The Power of Now"
revolves around the central theme of mindfulness and the importance of living
in the present moment. Tolle contends that the mind's incessant chatter,
dwelling on the past or worrying about the future, prevents individuals from
fully experiencing the richness of life. By learning to silence the mind and
embrace the present, readers can break free from the cycle of unhappiness and
connect with a deeper, more profound sense of self.</span></p><p><span style="font-size: 14.0pt;"><br /><br /><br /></span></p><div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"><a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEij4H-XGPtXZdHEBfo4mKjRjlfDzEAONIvF-GU7modtzF8_pvLuwEwLn7jMPq1eLyVxU4OxtSZHvPzawUSqWYyKUcf8fcnjpSxGemYqT9gJ0YlFpya7Nc4QCe4gQsIAlEfzq6VYdTgWd_LN_PA6fWDNQedcZQiKyy5xjc4FqvijUUpJ_ZUHmLXI0bUDarIg/s5567/mark-adriane-muS2RraYRuQ-unsplash.jpg" imageanchor="1" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"><img border="0" data-original-height="5567" data-original-width="3711" height="320" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEij4H-XGPtXZdHEBfo4mKjRjlfDzEAONIvF-GU7modtzF8_pvLuwEwLn7jMPq1eLyVxU4OxtSZHvPzawUSqWYyKUcf8fcnjpSxGemYqT9gJ0YlFpya7Nc4QCe4gQsIAlEfzq6VYdTgWd_LN_PA6fWDNQedcZQiKyy5xjc4FqvijUUpJ_ZUHmLXI0bUDarIg/s320/mark-adriane-muS2RraYRuQ-unsplash.jpg" width="213" /></a></div><br /><br /> <p></p>

<p><span style="font-size: 14.0pt;">The book draws from Tolle's own spiritual
awakening, a pivotal moment in his life where he experienced a profound inner
transformation. Through a combination of personal anecdotes, spiritual
teachings, and practical insights, Tolle guides readers toward a heightened
awareness of their thoughts, emotions, and the world around them. He introduces
the concept of the "pain-body," the accumulation of past emotional
pain that influences present behavior, and offers practical techniques for
transcending it.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size: 14.0pt;">"The Power of Now" is not just a
philosophical exploration but a practical guide filled with exercises and
meditations aimed at helping individuals integrate mindfulness into their daily

acceptance as pathways to true freedom and fulfillment. As readers delve into
the pages of this book, they are invited to explore the transformative power of
the present moment and discover a profound sense of peace and contentment that
goes beyond the limitations of the mind.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 72.0pt; mso-list: l0 level2 lfo1; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 72.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Courier New"; font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Courier New"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">o<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">

inner turmoil and depression. He experienced intense emotional suffering, which
eventually led him to question the nature of his own existence.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 36.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">2.<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">   
</span></span></span><b><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;">Spiritual Awakening:</span></b><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 72.0pt; mso-list: l0 level2 lfo1; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 72.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Courier New"; font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Courier New"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">o<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">

experienced a radical and life-altering spiritual awakening. One night, he
found himself in a state of deep despair, contemplating suicide. In that
moment, he had a profound realization that he was separate from his thoughts
and that there was a deeper, timeless dimension beyond the mind.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 36.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">3.<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">   
</span></span></span><b><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;">Years of Transformation:</span></b><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 72.0pt; mso-list: l0 level2 lfo1; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 72.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Courier New"; font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Courier New"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">o<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">

years in a state of contemplation and inner stillness. He lived a simple and
relatively reclusive life, delving into spiritual literature and teachings from
various traditions. During this period, he honed his understanding of the
nature of consciousness and the importance of living in the present moment.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 36.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">4.<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">

workshops and talks in the late 1980s. He gained a reputation as a compelling
and transformative speaker, drawing audiences with his unique ability to
communicate profound spiritual truths in a simple and accessible manner.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 36.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">5.<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">

Now":</span></b><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 72.0pt; mso-list: l0 level2 lfo1; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 72.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Courier New"; font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Courier New"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">o<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">  
</span></span></span><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;">"The Power of Now" emerged as a
distillation of Tolle's teachings and experiences. Initially published in 1997,
the book gained gradual recognition, and its popularity skyrocketed in the
following years. Tolle's ability to articulate complex spiritual concepts in a
way that resonates with a wide audience contributed to the book's widespread
success.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 36.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo1; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">6.<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">

Now," Eckhart Tolle has become a globally recognized spiritual teacher. He
has written several other best-selling books, including "A New
Earth," and continues to conduct workshops and retreats worldwide, sharing
his wisdom on the transformative power of presence and consciousness.</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 72pt; text-align: center; text-indent: -18pt;"><span style="font-size: 14.0pt;"><a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEg0_kAj9v94Jv-nTcY_ptS-nWUR0oWgUJTXCmfzwhfhpkmxJsgebXHYQLsKX11woJacb8xtmq4sOhE4lgJVqCRoRctnUz5EOwXfJH8yltrhBEiiTOSWFZ0Q4irs5xoufJzkVe3jts2KDLUJrzymub0TbbJRPjuJVX8K0lLEfsU3zEX9lDKCY2Swego6zj9n/s5472/paul-pastourmatzis-8kDOOrs608I-unsplash.jpg" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"><img border="0" data-original-height="3078" data-original-width="5472" height="180" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEg0_kAj9v94Jv-nTcY_ptS-nWUR0oWgUJTXCmfzwhfhpkmxJsgebXHYQLsKX11woJacb8xtmq4sOhE4lgJVqCRoRctnUz5EOwXfJH8yltrhBEiiTOSWFZ0Q4irs5xoufJzkVe3jts2KDLUJrzymub0TbbJRPjuJVX8K0lLEfsU3zEX9lDKCY2Swego6zj9n/s320/paul-pastourmatzis-8kDOOrs608I-unsplash.jpg" width="320" /></a></span><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"> <br /></span></p>

<h1><a name="_Toc156841854"><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN;">The Essence of the Present Moment : Exploring the
core concept of living in the present moment as presented in the book.</span></a><span style="mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN;"></span></h1>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto;"><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;">"The Essence of the Present Moment"
is a fundamental concept explored by Eckhart Tolle in his transformative work,
"The Power of Now." This central theme is a cornerstone of Tolle's
teachings, encouraging readers to shift their focus away from the past and the
future, and to fully embrace the richness of life in the present moment.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 36.0pt; mso-list: l3 level1 lfo2; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">1.<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">   
</span></span></span><b><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;">The Illusion of Time:</span></b><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 72.0pt; mso-list: l3 level2 lfo2; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 72.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Courier New"; font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Courier New"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">o<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">  
</span></span></span><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;">Tolle challenges the conventional perception
of time as a linear progression, emphasizing that the past and the future are
mental constructs. He asserts that dwelling on the past or anxiously
anticipating the future distracts individuals from the only reality—the present
moment.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 36.0pt; mso-list: l3 level1 lfo2; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">2.<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">   
</span></span></span><b><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;">Escaping the Tyranny of
Thought:</span></b><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 72.0pt; mso-list: l3 level2 lfo2; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 72.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Courier New"; font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Courier New"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">o<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">  
</span></span></span><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;">Tolle highlights how the incessant chatter of
the mind, fueled by thoughts and judgments, can dominate one's consciousness.
By learning to detach from this mental noise, individuals can experience a
profound sense of stillness and clarity in the present moment.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 36.0pt; mso-list: l3 level1 lfo2; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">3.<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">   
</span></span></span><b><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;">The Power of Presence:</span></b><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 72.0pt; mso-list: l3 level2 lfo2; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 72.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Courier New"; font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Courier New"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">o<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">  
</span></span></span><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;">Central to Tolle's teachings is the idea that
true power and fulfillment are found in the state of presence. By cultivating
awareness and being fully engaged in the present, individuals can tap into a
wellspring of creativity, peace, and contentment.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 36.0pt; mso-list: l3 level1 lfo2; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">4.<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">   
</span></span></span><b><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;">Freedom from Emotional Pain:</span></b><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 72.0pt; mso-list: l3 level2 lfo2; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 72.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Courier New"; font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Courier New"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">o<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">  
</span></span></span><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;">Tolle introduces the concept of the
"pain-body," which represents the accumulated emotional pain from
past experiences. He emphasizes that by residing in the present moment,
individuals can disengage from the grip of the pain-body and break free from
the cycle of suffering.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 36.0pt; mso-list: l3 level1 lfo2; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">5.<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">   
</span></span></span><b><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;">Mindful Awareness:</span></b><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"></span></p>

worrying about the future prevents individuals from fully experiencing the
richness of the present moment. Tolle encourages breaking free from the
habitual trap of living in time.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 36.0pt; mso-list: l2 level1 lfo3; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">4.<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">

construct. The past and future exist only in the mind, and the present is the

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: normal; margin-left: 36.0pt; mso-list: l2 level1 lfo3; mso-margin-bottom-alt: auto; mso-margin-top-alt: auto; tab-stops: list 36.0pt; text-indent: -18.0pt;"><span style="font-family: "Times New Roman",serif; font-size: 14.0pt; mso-fareast-font-family: "Times New Roman"; mso-fareast-language: EN-IN; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">5.<span style="font: 7.0pt "Times New Roman";">

without identification or judgment, individuals can start to disentangle
themselves from the grip of time-related stress.</span></p>
